title: Battle on the Zuiderzee
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle on the Zuiderzee", at revision 1370603402, opens: "The Battle on the Zuiderzee was a naval battle during the Eighty Years' War in which a Dutch fleet triumphed over a larger and better-equipped Spanish fleet on the Zuiderzee." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2386251, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1573 naval battle in the Eighty Years' War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
